title: 'Article 370 abrogation gave J&K real freedom, fulfilled Syama Prasad Mookerjee's dream': BJP chief Nitin Nabin
description: Nabin alleged that the then Congress-led governments at the Centre and in J&K had imposed a curfew to prevent BJP workers from hoisting the Tricolour and that party workers had to secretly transport the national flag hidden inside bundles of newspapers printed in Jamm
